# Claims Assessment Memo

## Summary

Ferrous Gate Engineering Ltd (policy CC-1703) reported on 26 September 2026 the theft of a laptop and an external drive from a locked storage unit at a university library [notice of loss]. The theft was reported to the police on 28 September 2026 under reference CR/2026/4247 [police report]. The loss falls within clause 4.2 (Contents), and none of the exclusions in clauses 7.1, 7.3 or 7.5 defeats it on the file as it stands. I recommend accepting the claim, with a reserve of 4,732 dollars. Two points need confirming on file, set out below.

## Facts

- Ferrous Gate Engineering Ltd reported the loss under policy CC-1703 on 26 September 2026 [notice of loss].
- The loss is theft of a laptop and an external drive from a locked storage unit at a university library [notice of loss].
- The theft was reported to the police by Ferrous Gate Engineering Ltd on 28 September 2026, reference CR/2026/4247 [police report].
- The items were a laptop and an external drive. They were in a locked container at the time of the theft, which took place in a locked storage unit at a university library [police report].
- The laptop was supplied by Beacon Office Supply at 2,603 dollars [invoice 1].
- The external drive was supplied by Crane & Sons Electronics at 2,129 dollars [invoice 2].
- The file does not state the date of the theft, and it does not include the policy schedule [notice of loss] [police report] [policy].

## Coverage analysis

**Insuring clause.** Clause 4.2 covers loss of or damage to business contents at the premises named in the schedule, and at any other premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft [policy, cl. 4.2]. The cause of loss is theft [notice of loss] [police report]. The library is presumably not a scheduled premises, so cover depends on the items being in the insured's custody there. They were held in a locked storage unit, in a locked container [police report]. The file does not say in terms who held the key or the unit, and the schedule is not in the file. This should be confirmed.

**Other cover clauses.** Clause 4.5 (Transit) applies to loss while portable equipment is carried by an employee between premises, and nothing in the file describes that. Clause 4.7 (Escape of water) and clause 4.9 (Electrical surge) concern water and surge damage, and neither is alleged [policy, cl. 4.5, 4.7, 4.9] [notice of loss].

**Exclusions.**

- **Clause 7.1 (Unattended property).** This excludes theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared or public space, unless it was in a locked container or locked room at the time [policy, cl. 7.1]. A university library may be a shared space. The items were in a locked container in a locked storage unit at the time, so the exception in the clause applies and the exclusion does not [police report] [notice of loss].
- **Clause 7.3 (Wear and tear).** This excludes gradual deterioration [policy, cl. 7.3]. The loss is a theft and no deterioration is alleged, so the exclusion does not apply [notice of loss].
- **Clause 7.5 (Unproven loss).** This excludes a loss not reported to the police within seven days where theft is alleged [policy, cl. 7.5]. The police report is dated 28 September 2026, two days after the notice of loss dated 26 September 2026 [police report] [notice of loss]. The theft date is not stated in the file. The police report was within seven days of the theft if the theft occurred on or after 21 September 2026. The theft must have occurred on or before 26 September 2026, when it was reported to us [notice of loss]. The date of theft should be confirmed to close this point.

## Decision

Covered, under clause 4.2 (Contents) [policy, cl. 4.2]. Clauses 7.1, 7.3 and 7.5 do not exclude the loss on the present file. The decision is subject to confirming (a) the date of the theft, for clause 7.5, and (b) that the items were in the insured's custody at the library, for clause 4.2.

## Reserve

Under clause 9.1, the reserve is the sum of the invoices in the file, less the 250-dollar excess where the policy schedule applies one. Where no excess is shown in the schedule, none applies [policy, cl. 9.1].

- Invoice 1, laptop: 2,603 dollars [invoice 1]
- Invoice 2, external drive: 2,129 dollars [invoice 2]
- Sum of invoices: 4,732 dollars
- Excess: none deducted. The policy schedule is not in the file, so no excess is shown [policy, cl. 9.1].

**Reserve: 4,732 dollars.** If the schedule shows a 250-dollar excess, the reserve reduces to 4,482 dollars [policy, cl. 9.1].
